answer:
**Predicted probability of achieving efficacy PR with treatment at Age = 65: ≈ 0.395 (39.5%)**

Model: logistic regression, Age as the only predictor, fit by MLE (statsmodels `Logit`) on the 80 patient rows with y = 1 iff Efficacy = 'PR' (SD/PD = 0; PR occurs only in the treatment arm, Groups = 1).

Coefficients:
| term | coef | std err | p-value |
|---|---|---|---|
| const | 4.4466 | 1.451 | 0.002 |
| Age | −0.0750 | 0.024 | 0.002 |

P(PR | Age=65) = 1/(1+exp(−(4.4466 − 0.0750×65))) = **0.3952**.

Cross-check: an independent unregularized MLE fit (scipy BFGS) reproduced intercept 4.446582, slope −0.074954, P(65) = 0.395215 — agreement to <5e-7. (sklearn was not installable in this offline runner, so scipy MLE served as the equivalent cross-check.)
